The '''Large Planetary Vehicle Hangar''' is an announced ship module used to deploy the [[Rhino]] [[Surface Recon Vehicles|Surface Recon Vehicle]]. Frontier has stated that the Rhino is too large to deploy through the regular cargo hatch like other SRVs and instead drops from the new large planetary vehicle hangar.<ref name="frontier-first-look">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/news/beneath-surface-your-first-look-rhino Beneath the Surface - Your First Look at the Rhino], Frontier Developments, 6 August 2026.</ref><ref name="frontier-august-dev-log">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/news/elite-dangerous-august-dev-log-2026 Elite Dangerous: August Dev Log 2026], Frontier Developments, 27 August 2026.</ref>
